Pixel-art cover scene for the SirLocked detective case "The Glasshouse Oath".
Spoiler-free mood: SirLocked and his companion investigate the death of Professor Elian Marrow at Bellweather Glasshouse, where a priceless night-blooming orchid vanished during a midnight lamp failure. Across the glasshouse, pump room, study, and old orchid cellar, the investigators must compare botanical traces, fractured alibis, and the household's guarded oath to discover who carefully pruned the truth.

Show SirLocked as the recognizable detective focal point without revealing the culprit or solution.
